NewsArticle.Title: Political Activity Log
NewsArticle.Content:
Serious political actions are publicly displayed on Mundane Notices after midnight each day. This objectively informs all levels of player-government of important activity and authenticates its source.
The action is recorded if it is attempted within the political hall. Therefore, speak in the political hall with dignity and honor.
The political actions listed include: removal, supporting an action, and forgiving exile, banishment, or bar.
The roster of active officials now also lists the sponsor and the number of terms the official has served in that office. For example, if a Guard is in his fourth term, the number "4" appears after his name.
